title: GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide & Details
description: Discover how and where to pre-order the official GTA6 limited-edition PS5 controllers in black and white. Launching alongside the game on November 19, 2026.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide & Details

As the highly anticipated launch of *GTA6* approaches, Sony and Rockstar Games have teamed up to offer fans a special hardware treat. According to recent reports from gaming outlet Push Square, pre-order links for the official *GTA6* limited-edition PS5 controllers have gone live for players in the US and UK.

### Design Features of the Limited Edition Controllers

To celebrate the upcoming release, Sony and Rockstar are launching two distinct colorways for the DualSense controller:

* **Black Edition**: A sleek, dark aesthetic for a stealthy look.
* **White Edition**: A clean design that matches the standard PS5 console.

Both versions feature a striking **blue and purple faceplate** surrounding the thumbsticks and touchpad. The iconic ***GTA6* logo** is prominently printed directly on the touchpad, while the two hand grips feature distinct **palm tree indentations**, subtly nodding to the game's iconic setting.

### Release Date and Pre-Order Availability

Players in the United States and the United Kingdom can now access links to pre-order these collectible controllers. Both the black and white variants are scheduled to launch on the exact same day as the game: **19th November 2026**. 

### Editor's Take

Releasing themed controllers right alongside the game launch is a classic and effective move by Sony and Rockstar. With subtle details like the palm tree grips and the official logo on the touchpad, these limited-edition controllers are a must-have for dedicated fans looking to fully immerse themselves in the next era of Grand Theft Auto on launch day.
